column3: NKJV lacks “whole” before “island,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it. “Magician” is rendered “sorcerer.”
NKJV has “distributed their land to them by allotment,” following the Textus Receptus wording.

NKJV has “He gave them judges for about four hundred and fifty years,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “for about four hundred and fifty years. And after that He gave them judges.”
NKJV has “raised up,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “brought.”
NKJV has “to you,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to us.”
